env_allowlist.PATH: inherited for verified primary runtimes and ordinary local shell utilities; Lean/Lake/Elan/Python/Git/Bash/Bubblewrap are hash-verified, while unenumerated coreutils remain part of the incomplete TCB and block release
env_allowlist.HOME: inherited only for the pinned Elan toolchain and canonical read-only Lake cache

network_enforcement: Every Lean elaboration runs with --trust=0 through Bubblewrap --unshare-net, a read-only host root, a writable fresh temporary output directory, fixed locale and timezone, and one Lean worker thread. The outer Python verifier performs only local file, hash, process-identity, and Git-object checks and contains no socket, clone, fetch, update, or build operation. The inherited outer environment and unenumerated coreutils remain an incomplete TCB. This is shared warm-cache node evidence, not cold hermetic release evidence.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact ten-line PASS/FAIL-CLOSED status summary asserted by the verifier and mirrored in the receipt

scope_boundary: Network-isolated trust-zero target-scoped replay of the exact frozen statement, vendored analytic bodies, local proof, and proof-only trust probe. Covered IDs are validation subjects, not closure credit. Proof master acceptance, alternate-route reconciliation, per-node body and composition evidence, accepted foundation/TCB and source/readability profiles, complete transitive provenance/SBOM, clean-checkout empty-cache offline replay, and distinct signed independent verification remain fail-closed.
